Any engineer on the **Growth team** can sign off. Post the change in **#growth-eng** for approval.

This comes from the project's shared memory notes, not from the code. The repo has no CODEOWNERS file or other ownership record for the notifier. The current note says Growth has owned the notifier since 2026-09-01, after Dana Okafor moved to Platform.

There's also an older note in the store that says Dana Okafor has to approve template and copy changes. That one is out of date and the newer note replaces it. If someone points you to Dana, that's probably where it came from.

When you make the edit, the templates are in `services/notifier/templates/`. Update both `receipt.mjml` and its plain-text twin `receipt.txt` so they stay in sync, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML.
